description: Galelic Estrelacourt wears a rust-red knee-length wool tunic with restrained pale gold geometric woven trim at the split neckline, cuffs and hem over an ivory linen underlayer visible at collar and cuffs. A plain brown leather belt with a rectangular buckle and long narrow hanging end secures the tunic. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the outfit. His short dark hair is uncovered.
